cases.name: conflict-on-third-doc-keeps-first-two
cases.notes: §4 + §10 Pinned: commit-phase atomicity is per document — a.md and b.md are committed (api) before c.md's file-CAS fails; c.md's disk bytes are ingested (observed) and the request errors sync_conflict.

cases.name: observe-after-apply-echoes
cases.notes: §4 step 5: the api commit's `file_hash` is the rendered bytes, so the sync path observing the same bytes afterwards is an echo (no commit).
